m0-context.title: Load baseline context
m0-context.imperative:
Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-crew.md and
references/global-everyone.md), then the project deltas if present:
docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, plus the handoff and the
relevant packet. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope,
exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions); if incomplete,
block and return. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff loaded; handoff complete -- QUALITATIVE: no doctrine mechanically verifies an agent's comprehension of prose it read -- verified downstream by m1's own precondition, which depends on this having actually happened and doubles as a second check on it
the inherited global-crew doctrine file exists on disk to be read

check.command: cd <repo-root> && test $(python -c 'import pathlib,sys;print(sum(1 for _ in pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).glob(sys.argv[2])))' skills/_shared global-crew.md) -eq 1

postconditions.statement: the inherited global-everyone doctrine file exists on disk to be read

check.command: cd <repo-root> && test $(python -c 'import pathlib,sys;print(sum(1 for _ in pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).glob(sys.argv[2])))' skills/_shared global-everyone.md) -eq 1

handback.purpose: where this gate hands something back -- these are the engine's real, persistent channels, not a field to write prose into
handback.belief_worth_recording: spine_evidence attach -- lands in this gate's own evidence[]
handback.open_question_out_of_scope: spine_capture flag-candidate -- lands in the top-level triage_candidates[]
handback.concern_that_must_stop_this_gate: spine_halt block -- sets status blocked and appends to the top-level blockers[], bubbling to the parent named below
handback.note: there is NO engine verb that appends to a directives field on an active gate (amend rescope touches pending gates only), so this contract names verbs that persist rather than offering arrays that would render empty forever

m1.title: Turn the unused _RESOLVER_OWNED_TOKEN_RE import into a real assertion (carried finding)
m1.imperative:
Make the minimal change for this step. scripts/generate_spine.py:51 imports
_RESOLVER_OWNED_TOKEN_RE from init_work_area and no ast.Name node anywhere in
the module referenced it -- DESIGN_NOTE.md section 4 cites the regex in prose
("`<repo-root>` is resolver-owned -- verified,
`_RESOLVER_OWNED_TOKEN_RE.fullmatch("<repo-root>")` is true") but the
justification was wired to nothing. Do not simply delete the import. Add a
module-level assertion next to `_REPO_ROOT_TOKEN` that actually calls
`_RESOLVER_OWNED_TOKEN_RE.fullmatch(_REPO_ROOT_TOKEN)` and fails import if it
is ever false, then pin it with a test asserting
`_RESOLVER_OWNED_TOKEN_RE.fullmatch("<repo-root>")` is truthy and that a
non-resolver token like `<exact test command>` is not. Attest any
check:null precondition BEFORE start -- the engine refuses `start <id>` while
a precondition is unmet, so the order is attest-precondition -> start. This is
a test-after/inspection change (the assertion is a one-line invariant with no
meaningful failing-red state to encode), so collapse to the single
green/observable postcondition (c2) rather than a separate TDD-red attest.

preconditions.statement: context loaded and handoff complete -- QUALITATIVE: asserted by the depending step itself, per DESIGN_NOTE.md section 11's trust-but-verify precedent for preconditions -- m0-context's own postconditions are the mechanical half of this check

postconditions.statement: _RESOLVER_OWNED_TOKEN_RE is genuinely referenced in scripts/generate_spine.py and the pinning assertion is covered by a real, currently-collecting test

check.command: cd <repo-root> && test $(python -m pytest -q -k TestResolverOwnedTokenRegex --collect-only tests/test_generate_spine.py 2>/dev/null | grep -c '::') -ge 2 && python -m pytest -q -k TestResolverOwnedTokenRegex tests/test_generate_spine.py

constraints: Only scripts/generate_spine.py and tests/test_generate_spine.py may change for this step (Allowed Scope)
Do not delete the import without a documented reason -- turn it into a real assertion first, per the carried finding
A -k selector is a typed `selector` field on the pytest kind, never raw shell text -- there is no shell-text field to leave unquoted
